selected_evidence.summary: All BLS/grubby kernel entries contain `audit=1`, both before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID was f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to bd5d16f8-8c58-42ae-aeb6-f675376ba28a; node1 recovered to system state `running` with no failed units.
